Home · Services · Hydrafacial

Treatment

Hydrafacial

Cleansing, gentle exfoliation and hydration in one Hydrafacial session.

About the treatment

Hydrafacial combines cleansing, exfoliation, suction extraction and hydrating serums. We assess your skin first and choose the steps and products that suit its condition.

The session focuses on surface buildup, clogged pores and dehydration. Tell us about sensitivity, active irritation or recent treatments so we can decide whether to proceed or adjust the plan.

At a glance

  • Skin may look fresher after the session
  • Suction used for cleansing and extraction
  • Serums selected for hydration
  • Care for dullness and uneven texture
  • Assessment first, including for sensitive skin

The treatment process

  1. Consultation and assessment. We assess your skin and check for irritation or sensitivities before choosing the treatment steps.
  2. A personal plan. We explain the treatment options, likely results, possible side effects and cost before you decide.
  3. The treatment itself. We talk you through the session and check how you feel as we go.
  4. Aftercare and follow up. We explain how to care for the treated area and when to contact us or return for a review.

Expected results

You may notice softer, more hydrated skin after the session. Results vary and depend partly on your skin's starting condition and your home routine.

Recovery & downtime

Many people return to their routine shortly afterwards. Some temporary redness or sensitivity is possible. Follow the team's advice on makeup, sun protection and when to restart active skincare products.

Who is it for?

It may suit concerns such as dullness, congestion or dehydration. Sensitive or irritated skin needs careful assessment, and we may suggest waiting or choosing a different approach.

Frequently asked questions

Does Hydrafacial hurt?
You may feel suction and light pressure as the handpiece moves across your skin. Let us know if anything feels uncomfortable so we can adjust the session.
When will I see results?
Some people notice a fresher look and smoother feel straight after treatment. The extent and duration of the result vary by skin type and the products used.
How often should I have one?
We often discuss a gap of four to six weeks, but your skin's response and routine matter more than a fixed schedule. We can advise after your first visit.
